title: Anonymous user is sent to the sign-in page
preconditions: Not signed in
expected: The address becomes /login/?next=/ and the "Sign in" heading is shown.

title: User signs in with valid credentials
preconditions: Not signed in. Account demo_user / demo-password-123 exists
steps: Enter username demo_user and password demo-password-123
expected: The home page opens with the heading "You are signed in as demo_user". The role "user" is listed.

title: Sign-in with a wrong password is rejected
preconditions: Not signed in
steps: Enter username demo_user and password wrong-password
expected: The user stays on /login/. The error "Please enter a correct username and password" is shown.

title: Unknown username gets the same error as a wrong password
preconditions: Not signed in
steps: Sign in as demo_user with a wrong password and note the error text
Sign in as no_such_user_here with any password
expected: Both error texts are exactly the same, so the page does not reveal which usernames exist.

title: Deactivated user cannot sign in
preconditions: Not signed in. Account demo_inactive is switched off
steps: Enter username demo_inactive and password demo-password-123
expected: The user stays on /login/ and the sign-in error is shown.

title: User signs out
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user
expected: The home page is not shown: the address becomes /login/?next=/.

title: Header link "Files" opens the file manager
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user
expected: The address becomes /files/ and the "Files" heading is shown.

title: Regular user gets "access denied" on the admin panel
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user (no admin role)
expected: The page "403 — access denied" is shown instead of the user list.

title: Admin opens the admin panel
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin
expected: The "Users" page opens with the user list; demo_admin is in it.

title: Regular user does not see admin links in the header
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user
steps: Look at the links in the header
expected: "Files" is shown. "Users", "Roles" and "Audit" are not shown.

title: Anonymous user cannot open the file manager
preconditions: Not signed in
expected: The address becomes /login/?next=/files/; no files are shown.

title: Admin finds a user by search
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. Demo users demo_user01…demo_user10 exist
steps: Type demo_user05 in the search field
expected: demo_user05 is in the list. Other users, for example demo_user06, are not.

title: Admin creates a new user
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin
expected: The message "User <username> created." is shown. The user is found by search in the list.

title: New user can sign in
preconditions: An admin has created a new user with a known password
steps: Enter the new user's username and password
expected: The home page opens with "You are signed in as <username>".

title: Password made only of digits is rejected
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin
steps: Enter a new unique username and the password 52012000 twice
expected: The form shows "This password is entirely numeric." The search finds nothing: the user was not created.

title: Deactivated user cannot sign in any more
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A new active user exists
steps: In another browser, try to sign in as that user
expected: The message "User <username> disabled." is shown and the button changes to "Activate". The sign-in fails with the sign-in error.

title: Admin grants the admin role
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A new user without roles exists
steps: Open /manage/ and click "Roles" in the user's row
expected: The message "Roles of <username> updated" is shown. The user's row shows the "admin" role.

title: Admin revokes a role
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A new user with the "user" role exists
expected: The user's row no longer shows the "user" role.

title: Cancel on the roles form changes nothing
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A new user without roles exists
expected: The user still has no "admin" role.

title: Admin cannot remove the admin role from themselves
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin
steps: Open the roles form of demo_admin
expected: The error "You cannot take the admin role from yourself…" is shown. demo_admin keeps the "admin" role.

title: Role change is written to the audit log
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A new user without roles exists
steps: Grant the "user" role to the new user
expected: The newest record shows: who = demo_admin, action = granted, role = user, to whom = the new user.

title: Roles page counts a new member
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A new user without roles exists
steps: Open /manage/roles/ and note the number of users in "admin"
Grant the "admin" role to the new user
expected: The number of users in "admin" has grown by exactly 1.

title: Create a nested folder and come back by breadcrumbs
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Click the working folder's name in the breadcrumbs
expected: 1: the folder is in the list. 2: it shows "Folder is empty." 3: the working folder is open and the new folder is in it. 4: the root is open and the working folder is in it.

title: Folder with a taken name is not created twice
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Create a folder with the same name again
expected: A message with "already exists" is shown. There is only one folder with that name.

title: Cancelling folder deletion keeps the folder
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
expected: The folder is still in the list.

title: Deleting a folder removes it with its contents
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Create a folder and upload a file into it
Go back to the working folder and click "Delete" next to the new folder
expected: Step 2: a warning says the folder will be deleted with everything inside. Step 3: "Deleted: <name>." is shown and the folder is gone.

title: Rename a folder
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Enter a new name and click "Save"
expected: "Renamed to <new name>." is shown. Only the new name is in the list.

title: Upload a file with a Cyrillic name
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Choose a text file named like "отчёт.txt" in "Upload files"
expected: "Uploaded files: 1." is shown. The file is in the list with the correct name and type "file".

title: Upload several files at once
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Choose two text files together in "Upload files"
expected: "Uploaded files: 2." is shown. Both files are in the list.

title: Download returns the same file
preconditions: Signed in. A file with known content is uploaded to the working folder
expected: The browser downloads a file with the same name and the same content.

title: Rename a file
preconditions: Signed in. A file is uploaded to the working folder
steps: Enter a new name and click "Save"
expected: Only the new name is in the list.

title: Delete a file after confirmation
preconditions: Signed in. A file is uploaded to the working folder
expected: "Deleted: <name>." is shown and the file is gone from the list.

title: File one byte over the size limit is rejected
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/. The size limit is known (5 MB in docker-compose)
steps: Choose a file 1 byte bigger than the limit
expected: A message with "is larger than the allowed" is shown. The file is not in the list.

title: File with a taken name is not overwritten
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/
steps: Upload same_name.txt with the text "first version"
Upload another same_name.txt with the text "second version"
expected: Step 2 shows a message with "already exists". The downloaded file contains "first version".

title: Regular user cannot change roles by a direct request
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user (no admin role). The roles form is hidden from this user
steps: Send the roles form of demo_user straight to the server (POST /manage/users/<id>/roles/) with the admin role ticked and a valid CSRF token
expected: The server answers 403 with the page "403 — access denied". demo_user still has no admin role.

title: Regular user cannot switch a user off by a direct request
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user. Another active user exists
steps: Send "Deactivate" for that user straight to the server (POST /manage/users/<id>/toggle-active/) with a valid CSRF token
expected: The server answers 403 with the page "403 — access denied". The user is still active.

title: Admin cannot switch off their own account
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin
expected: The message "You cannot switch yourself off." is shown. demo_admin stays active.

title: Signed-in user loses access as soon as they are switched off
preconditions: A user is signed in in one browser. An admin is signed in in another browser
expected: The user is sent to /login/?next=/ without signing out by hand.

title: Revoking a role is written to the audit log
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. A user with the "user" role exists
steps: Untick "user" in the user's roles form and save
expected: The newest record shows: who = demo_admin, action = revoked, role = user, to whom = the user.

title: Switching a user off is written to the audit log
preconditions: Signed in as demo_admin. An active user exists
expected: The newest record is about this user. Known bug #142: the app does not record this yet; the test is marked xfail.

title: File exactly at the size limit is accepted
preconditions: Signed in. An empty working folder is open in /files/. The size limit is known (5 MB in docker-compose)
steps: Choose a file exactly as big as the limit
expected: "Uploaded files: 1." is shown and the file is in the list. Together with TC-33 this checks both sides of the limit.

title: Path that climbs out of the storage is refused
preconditions: Signed in as demo_user
expected: The server answers 400. No file list is shown.

title: Sign-in does not send the user to another site
preconditions: Not signed in
expected: The home page of the app opens. The address is not evil.example.
